# cb:b026 · dag-structural-types

> DAG node type field accepts exactly three values (primitive, compound, implication) and determines which other fields are meaningful

**Type:** prescription (contract-grade) · **Kind:** state-machine · **Domain:** system · **Status:** superseded
**Tags:** `dag-schema`, `type-system`
**Created:** 2026-04-12

## Invariants

- Every active node has exactly one type
- type is a closed enum: primitive | compound | implication
- Only implications can carry rules or invariants
- Structural type determines valid operations (only implications are materialized)

## Rules

```json
{
  "given": "A node is being written to the DAG",
  "scenario": "Structural type validation",
  "then": "The type must be one of: primitive, compound, implication",
  "when": "The type field is validated"
}
{
  "given": "A node has type: primitive",
  "scenario": "Primitive carries a source",
  "then": "The node must have a non-null source field",
  "when": "The node is validated"
}
{
  "given": "A node has type: compound or type: implication",
  "scenario": "Compound and implication carry deps",
  "then": "The node must have a non-empty deps array",
  "when": "The node is validated"
}
{
  "given": "A node has rules or invariants populated",
  "scenario": "Only implications can carry contracts",
  "then": "The node must have type: implication (primitives and compounds cannot carry contracts)",
  "when": "The node is validated"
}
```
